one_liner: DropGen is a newly recognized ETH Zurich spin-off developing miniaturized liquid handling for high-throughput screening, with early support from Venture Kick.

top_signals.signal: ETH Zurich recognized DropGen as a spin-off in its 2026 roster.
DropGen received CHF 10,000 from Venture Kick’s first support stage in 2025.

Model score 84.2 of 100 (at the top of the reference cohort). The spin-off status, three known founders, doctoral training, a co-founder serving as CTO, and a deep-tech classification pushed the score up. The technical-founder and top-university founder flags also helped but are not confirmed by the founder records.

team: Dr. Claudius Dietsche (CEO), Dr. Maximilian Breitfeld (CTO), and Prof. Dr. Petra S. Dittrich (Chief Scientific Officer) are listed as co-founders, all with PhDs.
why_early: Unknown whether a priced round has occurred. The disclosed CHF 10,000 was first-stage Venture Kick support.
devils_advocate_risks: Established labs may be slow to switch to a microdroplet array platform.
It is unknown whether the platform can scale reliably across different screening applications.
next_step: HTGF Life Sciences & Chemistry team: Ask the founders what performance threshold their first target lab would require before switching to DropGen’s platform.
